services.desc: We are celebrating our 55th Anniversary in Dana Point! Save $10 on every adult whale watching ticket with code DW55. Use it all year! (excludes 1/2 price Tuesday) Discover the beauty of Dana Point Harbor in unparalleled style aboard our luxury 12-passenger Duffy boat. This private electric vessel offers a unique and intimate way to explore the tranquil waters at your own pace. Departing conveniently from Dana Wharf, located directly in front of the historic Turk’s Restaurant and Proud Mary’s, your harbor adventure begins immediately. Step aboard, a spacious 22-foot electric Duffy boat, and elevate your harbor cruise experience. Designed for luxurious comfort and effortless entertaining,
